summary.piece: Swimming torpedo water-mode and surface-exit tracing
summary.real_state: GameProjectileRow swimming water byte, refreshed world position and launch-retained swim_depth; actual projectile Type and descriptor ExplWaterHit/NoGravity; live ocean sampler.
summary.behavior: Replace the swimming torpedo's forced no-crossing result with the native medium-selected entry/exit trace. A crossing clears its water state and restores class air gravity; re-entry retains the existing swim controller and does not repeat its constructor random draw.
summary.assumption: The host's swimming cell represents the successful water-entry byte on this already-swimming path; this change does not infer native launch activation from it.
limitations: The mode query is adopted for the already-swimming torpedo sweep path; full 006E1300 movement dispatch and launch activation remain separate work.
Air/water trail effect owners are absent, so 006E6410 trail stop/resume is unhosted; its whole body is not claimed as wired.
Build, fixture and entry-reachable compiled-call evidence only; no game run or binary ABI replacement validation.
